audit.why: EVEN at 6/10 fits 52.44% over 2687 games: Nautilus owns levels 2-3 and the level-6 dive, Gangplank owns everything from Sheen onward. The prose already frames it that way.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Gangplank levels 2 and 3 and 'Skill' at level 6, directly contradicting whys[1], whys[2] and whys[4], which all say Nautilus edges those stages.
audit.why: whys[1]: 'Nautilus spikes at 2 with hook plus Staggering Blow auto-root before your kegs come online'. whys[2]: 'He still edges level 3'. whys[4]: 'this window leans Naut'. The packet levelChart marks all three Nautilus.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group: Level 2 = Nautilus 4/10, Level 3 = Nautilus 4/10, Level 6 = Nautilus 4/10. Level 1, 4-5, first item and 2+ items unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dredge Line's terrain behaviour is nowhere in the entry, and no cooldown or range is given for the ability the whole matchup is built around.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus towards it.' He can therefore hook a wall to close or cut off a retreat, and Gangplank has no dash to answer — Flash is the escape and it must be saved for that, not for damage. Dredge Line is 14/13/12/11/10 at 1150 range.
audit.corrected: Terrain-hook and the 14s / 1150 numbers stated in the cooldown breakdown, the interactions report line and the don'ts.

audit.why: The entry already gets the hardest hidden point right: Remove Scurvy cleanses the Depth Charge knockup and the Staggering Blow root, and the W-timing discipline is the real skill test here.

edits.before: - Nautilus Dredge Line: matchup-defining — His only engage. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Nautilus Dredge Line (14s at rank 1, 1150 range): matchup-defining — dodge it; he can also hook terrain to close. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: His only engage. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only engage, 14s at rank 1. Commit once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Track Nautilus's Dredge Line (Hook): His only engage. Dodge it. When it is down — Barrel-Q + R him.
edits.after: Track Dredge Line (14s, 1150): he also hooks terrain to cut you off. When it is down — Barrel-Q + R him.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His first hit on you roots — that is what turns a hook into a combo.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: You have no dash and he hooks terrain to cut the retreat — hold Flash for the wall, not the damage.

edits.before: This is where you take over. Once Sheen lands, a Sheen-empowered Parrrley detonating a full Powder Keg chain bursts and slows him, and a tank Nautilus has zero dash to escape a keg field, only his hook to peel. He can never burst you back, so your only losing condition is his perma-CC catching you out for the team, which means side-laning behind Cannon Barrage zoning and never face-checking a Dredge Line. Out-scale him, control objectives with global R pressure, and let your barrels do the rest.
edits.after: This is where you take over. Once Sheen lands, a Sheen-empowered Parrrley detonating a full Powder Keg chain bursts and slows him, and a tank Nautilus has zero dash to escape a keg field, only his hook to peel. He can never burst you back, so your only losing condition is his perma-CC catching you out, and with no dash of your own remember Dredge Line pulls him to terrain to cut your retreat — hold Flash for that wall, not the damage. Out-scale him, control objectives with global R pressure, and let your barrels do the rest.

notes: The packet flagged 'His Depth Charge' in whys[4] as a probable wrong name — false positive, Depth Charge is Nautilus's real R. No text change made for it. Whether minions block Dredge Line is not in Riot's description, so I did not assert it either way.
